steps.verify: Checker reads commit history in GitHub Enterprise and the moves show a timestamped trail.

steps.title: Reconcile the superseded count to the archived count in Confluence
steps.sop: Software Engineer is done when the counts match with 0 unarchived stragglers.
steps.verify: Checker compares the two counts in Confluence and the delta equals 0.

steps.title: Log each unresolved reference as a Doc-Cleanup item in Jira
steps.sop: Software Engineer holds the affected doc, done when the item has a 10-business-day SLA.
steps.verify: Checker opens Doc-Cleanup items in Jira and each carries an owner plus SLA date.

steps.title: Record the archive close-out approval on the review page in Confluence
steps.sop: Software Engineer records the close-out approval once every doc is archived or held.
steps.verify: Checker opens the review page in Confluence and the approval entry is present.
